{{Top|leg}}
'''Dashh''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Dashh once used a [[T-289 gas grenade]] on a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]; while the grenade eventually worked, the Wookiee's temper allowed him to get some hits in on Dashh. The bounty hunter spent a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] receiving [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatments that cost more than the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
